IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight dark brown hair stands on a
lawn in front of a stone building with
arched windows. She wears a fitted
purple button-front top with a lace trim,
layered over a thin tan camisole.
Low-rise purple cargo trousers with a
studded belt and a silver pendant
necklace complete the look. She holds a
patterned backpack by its strap. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft,
natural daylight. Palette of plum, stone
gray, and muted green. Collegiate and
grunge-inspired, in the style of a fall
campus lookbook.
